name: Writer's Hoard
purpose: Draft, edit and query manuscripts through the Writer's Hoard AI bridge: projects, chapters, notes, outline, search, worldbuilding.

x-family.note: A desktop app: the port answers only while the AI bridge is switched on in Settings. The token lives under the user's profile, not in the repository folder. DATA_DIR is the app's own archive folder (the ZIP snapshots it rotates itself): a consistent copy of every project, small, never the live IndexedDB store or the media cache.

notes: The AI bridge is off by default; turn it on in Writers Hoard → Settings → AI bridge. /api/health answers without a token; every other route needs the bridge token as a Bearer.
